response.sql: WITH grouped_data AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaingb, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) as avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as mean_val FROM grouped_data) SELECT gd.zoneref, gd.insurstat, gd.avg_remaingb, gd.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, gd.avg_remaingb / om.mean_val as ratio FROM grouped_data gd, overall_mean om WHERE om.mean_val IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
